sources.title: GitHub - agreemagoel/RiskLens: RiskLens — AI-powered credit & fraud ...
sources.snippet: RiskLens RiskLens is an AI-powered credit and fraud risk intelligence platform built to mirror how a real bank or fintech risk team would approach credit and fraud analytics — from raw transaction/customer data through machine learning models, explainability, and executive reporting, entirely on free, local infrastructure.

sources.title: GitHub - Pranav160705/RiskLens-AI: AI-Powered Transaction Risk ...
sources.snippet: RiskLens AI is an AI-powered transaction risk assessment platform designed to identify potentially fraudulent transactions using machine learning, behavioral risk indicators, explainable risk scoring, and AI-assisted investigation.

sources.title: RiskLens AI | SEC 10-K/10-Q Risk Intelligence
sources.snippet: RiskLens AI helps teams turn SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings into structured risk, financial table, market, and news intelligence with an AWS-powered agent workspace.

sources.title: RiskLens AI | Explainable Credit Risk Intelligence
sources.snippet: A credible lending model is more than an algorithm. RiskLens documents the data, split strategy, calibration, operating threshold, subgroup behavior, explanations and post-deployment drift.

sources.title: Using AI/ML to build a Fraud Detection Model - Pradeep Loganathan's Blog
sources.snippet: In this blog post we will build an effective fraud detection model using AI and machine learning techniques. We will explore the entire process, from data preprocessing to model deployment, and highlight key strategies to enhance detection accuracy.
